notify_user.desc: Send a non-blocking fire-and-forget notification. Use for progress updates like "Starting analysis…" or "Build complete." — never blocks. For questions that need an answer, use ask_user instead.

params.title: Notification title. Default: "AI Assistant"
params.duration_seconds: How long the toast stays visible (Windows/Linux only). Default: 5 s.

ask_user.desc: Ask the user a short question via a browser dialog. Opens the dialog immediately and returns a token — call get_user_response(token=…) to retrieve the answer. Use ONLY for discovery questions that require a user decision or clarification — NOT for writing solutions, explanations, or progress updates. Long answers, code, and summaries belong in your terminal/chat response, not in this dialog. Keep the question concise. If your environment has other tools also named ask_user, use this one (bmcptools).

params.question: A short, focused question. Do NOT include long reasoning, solutions, or explanations here — write those in your response text instead. Ask one clear question only.
params.details: Optional supplementary context rendered as markdown below the question. Use this for things the user needs to see alongside the question — e.g. a summary of what you just changed, your current findings, or relevant background. Keep the question itself short; put the substance here. Supports full markdown: headings, bold, italic, lists, tables, code blocks, links, blockquotes, and horizontal rules.
params.title: Dialog window title. Default: "AI Assistant"
params.subtitle: Subtitle shown below the title (e.g. your agent name).
params.choices: Optional quick-reply chips. User can tap a chip and/or type a custom reply.
params.allow_freeform: Allow freeform text input alongside choices. Default: true.
params.notify: Flash taskbar and send a toast when dialog opens. Default: true.

get_user_response.desc: Poll for a pending ask_user or rest response. Each call blocks up to wait_seconds (default 55, max 115) before returning. Returns the user's answer string when ready, or a PENDING string when still waiting. IMPORTANT: keep calling this in a loop until you get a non-PENDING answer — the user may take a long time to reply. Never give up after one PENDING.

params.token: The token returned by ask_user or rest
params.wait_seconds: Seconds to wait per poll. Default: 55. Max: 115.

update_dialog.desc: Send a live update into an open non-blocking ask_user dialog (macOS and Windows). Messages appear instantly in the user's browser in a scrollable "updates" panel with timestamps — no page refresh. Useful for sharing thinking state or context while waiting for the user's reply. Messages are rendered as markdown.

params.message: The message to display in the dialog. Rendered as markdown — supports headings, bold, italic, lists, code blocks, etc.
params.replace_last: When true, replaces the most recent update instead of appending a new one. Useful for streaming progress updates (e.g. percentage counters). Default: false.

cancel_ask_user.desc: Cancel an open ask_user dialog identified by its token. The browser dialog will dismiss immediately and get_user_response will return a cancellation message. Use this when the question is no longer relevant — e.g. you already have the answer from another source, the task was aborted, or you are about to ask a different question with a new ask_user call.

rest.desc: Let the AI go idle and show an 'AI is resting' browser page with a wake-up button. IMPORTANT: call this tool — do NOT end the conversation or stop responding — whenever the user says 'take a rest', 'wait', 'stand by', or 'I will review'. Workflow: (1) call rest() — it returns a JSON object with "status", "token", and "instructions" fields, (2) extract the "token" value from the JSON, (3) loop on get_user_response(token=…) indefinitely until the user clicks the wake-up button and you get a non-PENDING response. macOS and Windows only. Not supported on Linux.

params.notes: Message shown to the user while resting. Rendered as markdown.
params.title: Name shown in the resting UI. Default: "AI Assistant"
params.subtitle: Optional subtitle, e.g. your agent or model name.
params.timeout_seconds: Max seconds before auto-waking. Default: 3600. Max: 86400.
